data.narrative:
Exodys Energy is a seed-stage nuclear energy company that has raised $10M+ to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies, with notable private peers including Nano Nuclear Energy, X-Energy, Fuse Energy, and Applied Atomics.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total raised ($10M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $25M. This method directly reflects Exodys Energy's capital raised and expected progression trajectory within the frontier nuclear subsector.

The peer-median approach is not applicable due to insufficient comparable data. While the nuclear energy sector contains 4 same-sector peers, none of the narrow peer filters—same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier—produced the minimum three datapoints required for reliable median analysis. A broader cross-sector median would introduce material noise.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $21M (low) to $29M (high), with a median of $25M. This single-method support reflects the early stage and nascent market dynamics of frontier nuclear technology. Key uncertainties include the technical maturity and IP position relative to the broader peer set, capital requirements for the next development phase, and market timing for commercial deployment within the nuclear subsector.
